title: PhysicalDataComponent
description: TOGAF-sourced structural archetype — physical data storage and access infrastructure (database, file system, data lake). An active system: it has Mechanisms (CRUD operations, query processing, replication), Effectors (query results, change events), Receptors (writes, commands). Extends Structure with TOGAF Data Architecture vocabulary. TOGAF mapping: Physical Data Component (Content Metamodel, Data Architecture domain). Source framework: TOGAF (Data Architecture, Content Framework).

storageType.description: Storage technology classification. TOGAF mapping: Physical Data Component storage mechanism type.

persistenceModel.description: Data persistence characteristic. TOGAF mapping: informs data lifecycle and governance strategy.
